paragraphs: R' Shimon ben Avishalom: Hazakat ha-Batim; Berakhot 7b; Yalkut Tehillim, no. 50. But Ein Yaakov's reading, R' Shimon ben Yohai, is a scribal error. R' Shimon ben Avishalom said: Megillah 14a; Yalkut Shoftim, chapter 4.
